title: Stateless Onboarding Assessment & Encrypted SMTP Dispatch
description: End-to-end automated pipeline from employee quiz submission to in-memory PDF synthesis and TLS email delivery without persistent cloud storage.

actions.name: Authenticate_Session
actions.description: Verify URL key parameter or manual password input against backend st.secrets.ACCESS_CODE.

actions.name: Evaluate_Assessment_Score
actions.description: Compare submitted answers against isolated st.secrets.QUESTIONS_JSON answer keys.

actions.name: Normalize_Timestamp
actions.description: Capture current UTC time and convert to Hong Kong Standard Time (UTC+8).

actions.name: Synthesize_Controlled_PDF
actions.description: Render vector A4 PDF in RAM using FPDF2 and embedded CJK font without writing to disk.

actions.name: Dispatch_Encrypted_Email
actions.description: Transmit assessment summary and PDF attachment directly to HR mailbox over TLS.

actions.name: Purge_Session_Memory
actions.description: Release PDF byte stream and clear PII from session state upon completion or reset.
